root.name: マラソン・ペトロリアム

relations.text: マルティネス再生可能ディーゼル事業は、ネステと折半出資の合弁である
relations.text_en: The Martinez renewable diesel joint venture is a 50/50 joint venture with Neste Corporation

source.label: Marathon Petroleum 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: The Martinez renewable diesel joint venture (the “Martinez Renewables joint venture”) is a partnership structured as a 50/50 joint venture with Neste Corporation to refine renewable feedstocks into renewable diesel.

companies.name: アーチャー・ダニエルズ・ミッドランド

relations.text: グリーン・バイソン大豆処理の合弁は、ADMが75%、同社が25%を持つ
relations.text_en: In the Green Bison Soy Processing JV, ADM owns 75 percent and MPC owns 25 percent

source.label: Marathon Petroleum 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: We formed the Green Bison Soy Processing, LLC (“Green Bison Soy Processing”) joint venture with Archer-Daniels-Midland Company (“ADM”) with ADM owning 75 percent of the joint venture and MPC owning 25 percent.

relations.text: ウィスラー・パイプラインの合弁会社の19%の議決権を、エンブリッジの関連会社に発行した
relations.text_en: A 19 percent voting interest in the Whistler pipeline joint venture was issued to an Enbridge affiliate

source.label: Marathon Petroleum 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: On May 29, 2024, MPLX and its joint venture partner contributed their respective membership interests in Whistler Pipeline, LLC to a newly formed joint venture, WPC Parent, LLC, and issued a 19 percent voting interest in WPC Parent, LLC to an affiliate of Enbridge Inc.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
